e22_esb_population: Every ESB utterance of this study's own registered Earnings-22 DEV subset10: 6,038 utterances cut locally from the ten locked earnings22-original MP3s at the segment boundaries of sanchit-gandhi/earnings22_split split TRAIN, pinned at revision f9fb35f4134e32b9c8100199d949398fd6d08a5f. All ten dev calls appear in that table (4453225 635, 4469088 922, 4470684 589, 4474506 633, 4479944 588, 4481952 632, 4482383 469, 4482613 592, 4483937 517, 4485192 461); none had to be dropped. 39,292.647 s = 10.915 h for one pass.
e22_esb_identity_hash_convention: e22_esb_split_identity_hash is data.splits.split_identity_hash(prefixed('earnings22-original', sample_ids)) over earnings22-original/<call>-<segment>, the value core.flight.FlightRuntime.preflight computes at flight time and the value an exposure row must carry.
e22_esb_d1_media_supplement: The utterance ids enter D1's identity closure through the additive media supplement named above (schema saea-d1-media-supplement-v1, the shape contracts.gate_media_identity reads); every one of the 6,038 is NEW to the immutable artifact by construction, and each chains to one of the ten parent calls whose media identity D1 itself recorded. The derived WAVs live under $SPEECHRL_DATA_DIR/derived/e22-esb-utterances/dev-v1/ -- a DIFFERENT root from the 2026-09-04 test population's derived/e22-esb-utterances/v1/ -- and never enter Git.
e22_esb_split_role_basis: No owner allowance is involved and none is claimed. These ten calls ARE this study's registered earnings22-original dev subset10 (docs/receipts/splits.json, split 'dev', count 10, identity 89b178d6b1ef46d9ca820ae54349e3d2099c60cde6d6b753ef9f66137c310028), which is the split this study may optimize on. No confirmatory call is named, loaded, decoded, scored or read by this fragment or by any run that composes it, and the six calibration-exposed ESB test calls stay a separate population with a separate roster, a separate reference layer and a separate derived media root.
e22_esb_reference_boundary: The 'sentence' column is gold and NEVER enters the request path. The roster receipt this fragment names carries identifiers, media paths, measured media identity and segment spans only. References live in their own hash-pinned derived layer that only reproduction.esb_reference (scoring side) resolves, as a SECOND layer beside the sealed 2026-09-04 test layer whose bytes are never touched.
e22_esb_clamped_to_decoded_parent: One utterance, 4481952-631, has an end_ts past its decoded parent and is clamped to it; it is named in the roster receipt and is named again in the verdict.
e22_esb_window_fit: The longest utterance is 4470684-13 at 78.360000 s -> 13 * ceil(78.36) = 1027 speech tokens, which is why this population needs the -c 40960 -np 8 geometry rather than the sealed test flight's -c 32768 -np 8; see configs/model/q4km-e22-dev-esb-mmproj-gpu-04ccc72a-np8-c40960.json.
